label: OpenWeather
agentGuide: GET /data/2.5/weather?q=Paris&units=metric&lang=en for the current weather, /data/2.5/forecast for five days in three-hour steps. Always set units=metric (otherwise the temperatures come in Kelvin) and lang= to the code of the user's language (en, fr, es, de…). Coordinates can be aimed at with ?lat=&lon= instead of ?q=. Do not add the key, it is set automatically.
